notes:
Moagram 13.2.2 preview 3

- Fixes phone heating and idle battery drain caused by the background notification service's 3-minute network wakeup loop, while keeping instant background notifications via Telegram's native push socket.
- Stops re-posting the dismissed Keep-Alive notification every time you reopen the app.
- Upgrades Download Speed Boost to 8 parallel connections with 512 KB pipelined chunks (8 MB in-flight window) for faster downloads on distant datacenters and lossy mobile networks.

Android 6.0 or later. Install over your existing Moagram app to keep accounts and settings.
critical_message: This update fixes background battery drain and phone heating, and upgrades Download Speed Boost to 8 parallel connections with 512 KB chunks. Please install it.
